senses.sense_definition: In or to a foreign country or countries.

examples.text: Many students choose to study <w>abroad</w> to learn a new language and experience a different culture.

senses.sense_definition: Outside of one's home or a confined space; outdoors.

examples.text: He always spoke of <w>abroad</w> as if it were one enormous, exciting country.

target_lang_translations.de: Er sprach immer vom <w>Ausland</w>, als wäre es ein einziges riesiges, aufregendes Land.
target_lang_translations.fr: Il parlait toujours de <w>l'étranger</w> comme s'il s'agissait d'un seul pays immense et passionnant.

examples.text: She has a great love for <w>abroad</w> and enjoys learning about different cultures.
